articles.title: No Cell Signal? No Problem: The First Satellite Dog Collar Is Here
articles.summary: Fi's new Ultra tracker connects to SpaceX's Starlink satellites, so your dog's location reaches you even in remote areas with zero cellular coverage. It's the first wearable for pets that uses direct-to-cell satellite tech, launching July 8.

articles.title: After a Decade of Trying, Physicists Finally Create a Long-Sought Quantum Material
articles.summary: Finnish researchers have fabricated the first 2D topological crystalline insulator, a quantum material predicted over 10 years ago. The atom-thin tin telluride film conducts electricity only along its edges, a property stable at room temperature.

articles.title: Splitting a Photon Would Unleash a Quantum Cascade of New Light Particles
articles.summary: A new theoretical study shows that attempting to sever a single photon would spawn a superposition of up to infinite photons. The bizarre prediction hinges on quantum vacuum fluctuations and the wave nature of light.
